name: d3xai
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.
rootCause: The D3XAT project ran an internal swap proxy whose exchange(fromToken, toToken, amount) function priced D3XAT independently of (and more cheaply than) the PancakeSwap market price, while the on-market PancakeSwap pool reflected the real, higher price. The proxy effectively let anyone buy D3XAT low and sell it high without a sanity check tying its quote to a manipulation-resistant reference. The attacker flash-loaned 20M USDT from a PancakeV3 pool, then ran two parallel legs: buying D3XAT cheaply through the proxy's exchange() and selling it back at a higher rate, while simultaneously round-tripping through the PancakeSwap router across many helper buyer/seller contracts to harvest the spread. Repeating this across 27+ rounds drained the price discrepancy for a net profit of ~190 BNB, after which the USDT flash loan plus fee was repaid. Vulnerable code snippet: Attack Tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0x26bcefc152d8cd49f4bb13a9f8a6846be887d7075bc81fa07aa8c0019bd6591f Analysis: https://x.com/suplabsyi/status/1956695597546893598

D3X AI (@D3X_AI) was attacked on BSC, resulting in a loss of approximately $158.9K. The root cause was that the exchange() function of contract 0xb8ad relied on the spot price of the d3xat token from a UniswapV2 pair, which the attacker exploited through a price manipulation attack.
